note: Positions, timings and choices for scene.py. Written by tools/scene_build.py from its tables: change a number there and rebuild, not here.

evening.note: day, evening, night: percent; night_from: minute of the day; see scene.settled_brightness.

weather.note: odds: one row for each month, January first. gloom: see scene.gloom_end.

months.note: art/palettes/<mm>/<state>.json is month mm in a lighting state. A month shows its own palette until its last fade_days days; on those it is mixed with the next month's, k parts in fade_days + 1, k = 1 on the first of those days (scene.month_mix).

meteors.note: showers: [month, day, month, day, one_in]: the Quadrantids, Lyrids, Perseids, Orionids, Leonids and Geminids.

specials.note: An item shows its sprite with the top-left pixel at `at` when the order reaches its slot, on a date that one of the rules of `when` names (scene.special_on), in the lighting states of `states` and from the hour hours[0] up to, not including, hours[1] (null: all). Its frame is ((tick + ahead) // ticks_per_frame) % frames; frame k is the part of the sheet at x = sheet[0] + k * sheet[2]. An item with days, every, move, jitter, once, fade or clear is a surprise: tools/scene_surprises.py describes those fields, the meteors and the tints; scene.special_piece, scene.meteor and scene.frame_colours read them.

house.note: The doghouse. house_back and house_front are full layers (full_layers), stamped before and after the dog. At house_shadow the part cast throws its shadow as a part of a pose does (see dog.note), with the dog's leans; at is from (dog.x, dog.y) like a part's. pose: the dog in the doorway, in the format of one of dog.poses; it is no part of their order. stay: he spends pose slot s (dog.pose_change) in the house, in pose, when at one of look_minutes minutes after the slot's first tick (s * hold; its minute of the day is the frame's time moved by the ticks from that tick to the frame's, floor) the weather of that minute is rain; or when at one of them the state of that minute and its weather is night and hash(s, 2, salt) % out_one_in is not 0 (scene.in_house).

glints.note: phase = (tick // ticks_per_step) % groups; group g shows when (g - phase) % groups < shown.

paths.note: phase = (tick // ticks_per_step) % frames; a path role shows when its name, after the prefix, holds the digit of the phase.

twinkle.note: Group g: s, at = divmod(tick + g * (slot // groups), slot). When hash(g, s, salt) % one_in == 0 it is a = slot // 2 - |at - slot // 2| parts in slot // 2 of the way to the colour of dim_to (scene.frame_colours).

beam.note: frame = (tick // ticks_per_frame) % frames; the strip holds the frames side by side.

rain.note: At tick t the tile has moved down by speed * t and left by speed * t // lean, wrapping: frame pixel (x, y) shows tile[(y - down) % tile_h][(x + left) % tile_w].

fade.note: A fade blends two finished frames per channel, (a * (steps - s) + b * s + steps // 2) // steps, s = 0..steps. A change of weather takes ticks ticks. A change of light (from one lighting state to the next at a fixed weather) takes light.minutes minutes in light.steps steps: into dawn or dusk in the minutes before it begins, otherwise in the minutes after the boundary (scene.state_fade).

states_note: sky, sea and sand are layers baked for the lighting state (Floyd-Steinberg dithering at build time, tools/scene_dither.py); states whose layer is the same share a file.
light_note: light_from is already in the palettes (the land roles); it is here to read, scene.py does not use it.

day_parts.note: sunrise and sunset: minutes after midnight in standard time on the 15th of each month, January first; between two 15ths the value changes evenly by the day, and 60 is added while summer_time is on (scene.sun_times). dawn and dusk are minutes from sunrise and sunset. Night is before dawn opens and after dusk closes.

moon.note: Phase k of 8 (0 new) is round(8 * days since the epoch new moon / month). New draws nothing, and path_moon is drawn only when the moon is.

clouds.note: x = (start_x + tick // ticks_per_px) % span + left; the sprite goes at (x + dx, row + dy). The first shown[weather] tracks are drawn; in clear weather the first shown_clear[month - 1].

dog.note: Each part of a pose is a file in art/, placed with its top-left corner at (x + at[0], y + at[1]); every frame of a part is its image with the active moves applied in order. At dog_shadow the flat parts are stamped, then each other part casts its shadow; at dog the other parts are stamped, in order. ground is a row for every column, or "outline": the lowest opaque row of each column of the file. shadow[key] = [ax, bx, ay, by]: a part pixel (px, py) at h = max(0, ground(px) - py) casts onto column x + at[0] + px + h * ax // bx, rows top .. top + thick - 1 with top = y + at[1] + ground(px) + h * ay // by, floor division (Java: Math.floorDiv). It lands only where the frame held, before any shadow was laid, a sand role (it becomes DOG_SHADOW) or a key of shadow_onto (it becomes the value). key is the state, or "no_moon" in a state that has a moon (moon.states) while no moon is drawn (frame 0, or weather that hides the clear-night layers). By day the lean is the month's entry of shadow_day, January first. pose_change: see scene.pose_at; a change is a whole-frame fade of fade_ticks ticks between the frames of the two poses.
